name: Nacho Sánchez Amor - § 43 - Am 27
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Türkiye
part_text: 43. Remains concerned by the Turkish Government’s use of the Turkish diaspora as an instrument for meddling in EU Member States’ domestic policies; notes, in this regard, that most of the imams of the German-Turkish Islamic association DITIB are sent directly from Türkiye, are subordinate to the Turkish religious authority Diyanet and follow its instructions; condemns previous threats of legal challenges by DITIB against German newspapers to silence criticism of certain practices within DITIB;
